name: Dalaran
tagline: Robotics data infrastructure and visualization for multimodal time-series, native to ROS 2
description: Dalaran is robotics data infrastructure and visualization built for multimodal time-series, with native ROS 2 support and the ability to read .rrd files. A hard fork of Rerun, it adapts the proven visualization stack to the specific needs of robotics pipelines. With 925 stars in six days, it claims a rare open-source robotics data-infra niche that had few credible options before.
highlights: Hard fork of Rerun, tuned for robotics data workflows
Native ROS 2 support out of the box
Reads .rrd files for multimodal time-series data
925 stars in six days in a sparse OSS robotics data-infra niche
Visualization plus data infrastructure in one project
curatorNote: Robotics lacks a solid open-source data-infrastructure layer, and Dalaran moves straight into that gap by hard-forking Rerun and making it ROS 2 native. The 925 stars in six days show just how hungry the robotics community was for this.
